Add The Inn-Sanity to Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3550710/Vasilisa

Team up with friends in this cooperative horror game set in a Post-Soviet village haunted by Slavic folklore. Gather mythical artifacts and stop the ancient darkness from consuming your kolkhoz.
